description: Claim Stakes: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Four claim stakes mark the khan's ore field in {system}. Someone has been pulling them. Fly close to each stake and hold until it answers. Pirates are sniffing around. Kill them if they come.
The khan's stakes in {system} need checking. Close in, hold, wait. Waiting is half of flying. Pirates will come. That is the other half.
success: Stakes checked, pirates dead. {client} pays {captain} and the Packmother's cooks send you a leg of something.
Claim intact and the thieves gutted. {client} pays.
failure: The stakes are unchecked and the pirates laugh. {client} pays nothing.
You failed the claim. The khan notices.
radio-stakes: Thrug: Four stakes! Fly close, hold still. I hate holding still!
Thrug: Stakes ahead. Be dull for a minute, then we fight.
radio-thrug: Thrug Two-Fangs on your wing. I have been looking for a good wingman. You will do.
Thrug: Wing is up! Do not fall behind, little hull!
radio-scrap: Thrug: Pirates, behind! Four of them! Good!
Thrug: They came to steal from the khan. Teach them.

description: Ore Train Raid: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Four {enemy} ore haulers are crawling through {system} with three escorts. The khan wants the ore. Kill the haulers, break the escorts. Plunder is shared by the wing.
A Hold League ore train in {system}. Slow, fat, and fond of contracts. We tear up the contracts. Take the haulers.
success: Haulers burning and the ore scattered for the khan's crews to gather. {client} pays {captain}. Old Mazka writes your share on a very long list.
The ore train is wrecked. {client} pays and you are told you flew like an orc.
failure: The haulers escape. {client} pays nothing and mutters.
The ore train is through. The khan will not forget.
radio-haulers: Thrug: Haulers! Slow as cows and just as stupid!
Thrug: Four dwarf ore ships. Break their backs!
radio-guard: Thrug: Three fighters guard them. They fly like they are being paid by the hour.
Thrug: Escort fighters. Kill them first, or kill them second.
radio-help: Thrug: More dwarves, right! They hurry because they have contracts!
Thrug: Dwarf reinforcements! Good, I was bored.

description: Dry Hold: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: The {stranded}, a Packmother tender, ran her tanks dry in {system}. She is dead in space and loud on the radio. Fly alongside, hold still, pass fuel. Pirates are already circling. Do not let them eat her.
A clan hauler is stranded. Match her speed and hold close while her crew take your fuel. It takes thirty seconds. Pirates will arrive in less.
success: The {stranded} is fuelled and furious about it. {client} pays {captain}. The tender master sends a barrel of something that burns.
Fuel passed, thieves dead. {client} pays and the clan sings your name badly.
failure: The {stranded} is lost. {client} pays nothing and the clan wails.
No fuel, no ship. The pirates feast.
radio-stranded: {stranded}: Khan's wing! We are dry! Come close and hold, and bring your guns!
{stranded}: Tanks empty, engines cold, tempers hot. Quick, now!
radio-first: Thrug: Pirates from ahead! Three! They heard the shouting!
Thrug: Fighters, ahead. Do not stop holding. I will deal with them. Probably.
radio-second: Thrug: Gunships left! They want the tender! Do not let them!
Thrug: More! The gunships go for the {stranded}!
radio-third: Thrug: Frigate behind us, and fighters! Big pirates! Good!
Thrug: They sent a frigate. We are being honoured.

description: The Tithe Barge: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: The khan's tithe barge {barge} crosses {system} today, carrying plunder for the Hold League as the price of a truce. The {enemy} have promised not to touch it. They have promised before. Escort her. Keep your guns warm.
Escort the {barge}. She carries the khan's tithe to the border. The dwarves agreed to let her pass. A dwarf agrees to many things, then reads the fine print.
success: The {barge} is through and the tithe delivered. The truce survives, if only on paper. {client} pays {captain}.
Barge delivered, ambush broken. {client} pays and Old Mazka is pleased.
failure: The {barge} is lost with the tithe. The truce is void. {client} pays nothing.
The khan's gift is gone. The war is back on.
radio-barge: {barge}: Khan's wing, we are loaded. Stay close and keep out of our way.
Thrug: The barge is slow. I like the barge. I will protect the barge.
radio-cut: Thrug: Dwarf fighters ahead! They said no contracts were broken! Liars!
Thrug: Gunships target the barge! Kill them!
radio-coalvein: Hadrin Coalvein: Orc pilots. The League objects to your cargo. Clause eleven, if you wish to argue.
Thrug: That is Coalvein, the dwarf with forty kills. I will have him.
radio-wardens: Thrug: A dwarf frigate, the {warden}, left! The wardens have come to taxes!
Thrug: Frigate and fighters, left. They do not give up.

description: Eyes on the Hold: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: The {enemy} have set a watch in {system}. The khan wants to know what it is watching. Fly close to each ship, hold, scan. Do not shoot. Dead ships cannot be scanned.
Reconnaissance, Captain. A quiet watch of Hold League ships in {system}. Scan every hull. Shoot nothing until the scan is done.
success: The scans show hold-forged armour plate and crates of guns in the supply hulls, enough for a fleet. {client} pays {captain} and starts shouting.
Scans taken. The League is arming. {client} pays and calls the clans.
failure: No scan, no knowledge. {client} sends you back, angrier.
The scan failed. The khan guesses instead.
radio-wardens: Thrug: Dwarf frigates, still as stone! I hate scouting!
Thrug: Two ships, no lights. Slow down. Slow! Down!
radio-screen: Thrug: Fighters circle them. They will see us if we go too close.
Thrug: A screen of four. Be a quiet orc. It is hard.
radio-buoys: Thrug: Supply hulls, right. Heavy. Why does a watch need so much?
Thrug: Three big freighters, holding. These are the ones to scan.
radio-react: Thrug: Dwarf hunters, behind! They noticed!
Thrug: Four interceptors. We have enough. Run, or kill them!
radio-wake: Thrug: Jump flash! A cruiser! The dwarves send their best!
Thrug: Big ship, far side. Time to leave.

description: Break the Ore Train: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: The League is moving a full ore train to its staging fleet, five haulers under the cruiser {warden}. Burn it. The dwarf ace Coalvein flies with it. Do not fight him alone, but do fight him.
Intercept the {enemy} supply train in {system}. Five haulers, one cruiser and a screen. It is the supply for their war. Starve them.
success: The ore train is ash. The League will have to dig more. {client} pays {captain} and the clans feast.
Haulers down. {client} pays and tells you to get some sleep.
failure: The train gets through. The League is ready. {client} pays nothing.
The haulers escape. Their staging fleet eats well.
radio-train: Thrug: Five haulers and a cruiser, the {warden}! A big fat feast!
Thrug: Train ahead. Kill the haulers. Leave the cruiser for later.
radio-screen: Thrug: Six fighters! They have actually brought a screen! Impressive!
Thrug: Screen up, ahead. Break through!
radio-coalvein: Hadrin Coalvein: Orcs. Your raid is out of contract. I will be collecting damages.
Thrug: Coalvein! He is here! Mine!
radio-hammer: Thrug: Gunships and hunters left! Dwarves hit hard when they are cornered!
Thrug: More of them. Good. I was getting dull.

description: Hearthhall Siege: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: The Hold League fleet is forming above the Hearthhall, a stone holdfast in {system}. We fight them now, before they finish. The {flagship} leads our line against their flagship {target}. Kill the {target}. Keep the {flagship} alive. Plunder after.
The khan has called every clan to {system}. The {enemy} fleet is in range and so is their flagship, the {target}. This is the war in one afternoon. Fight.
success: The {target} breaks apart over the Hearthhall. The League sues for peace and the clans sing for a month. {client} pays {captain} the full share, and the khan names you in the long list.
The League line breaks. {client} pays, and the plunder is considerable.
failure: The {flagship} is lost and the line with it. {client} pays nothing and calls a new moot.
The clans are beaten. The League keeps its Hearthhall.
radio-line: Brakka: Khan's fleet, this is the Warchief! We fight until they run or we are ash! Sound the horns!
Thrug: Wing, form on me! Or on the Captain! Whoever is in front!
radio-league: Thrug: Dwarf battlecruiser, the {target}! And cruisers! It is a proper war now!
Thrug: Their line is up! The {target} is the big one!
radio-swarm: Thrug: Bombers from above! They want the {flagship}! Kill them!
Thrug: Eight hunters and four gunships, high! Shoot them!
radio-coalvein: Hadrin Coalvein: Orc. I have a contract with your name on it. Clause paid in full.
Thrug: Coalvein again! Captain, he is yours or mine!
radio-reserve: Thrug: Carrier on the right, with more fighters! They really brought everything!
Thrug: Reserve fleet, right. Hold on!
radio-reinforce: Brakka: Fresh clans arriving! The horns were heard! Finish it!
Thrug: Our reinforcements! Louder than the dwarves, as ever!
